units.locator: Article 25.1. Person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted
units.text: 2. An administrative offence case shall be considered with the participation of the person against whom proceedings are conducted. In that person’s absence, the case may be considered only in the cases provided for by parts 3 and 3.1 of Article 28.6 of this Code, or where there is information confirming that the person was duly notified of the place and time of consideration and the person has not requested postponement of consideration or such a request has been refused.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 25.1

units.locator: Article 25.1. Person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted
units.text: 3. The judge, body or official considering an administrative offence case may declare the presence of the person against whom proceedings are conducted mandatory at the consideration of the case.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 25.1

units.locator: Article 25.1. Person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted
units.text: When a case concerning an administrative offence punishable by administrative arrest, administrative expulsion of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the Russian Federation, or compulsory work is considered, the presence of the person against whom proceedings are conducted shall be mandatory, except when considering a case concerning an administrative offence committed outside the Russian Federation and provided for by Article 13.48, part 9 of Article 19.34, part 4 or 5 of Article 20.1, or Article 20.3.1 or 20.29 of this Code, or an administrative offence consisting in failure to pay within the period specified by this Code an administrative fine imposed for an administrative offence under Article 13.14.1, 13.15, 13.36, 13.37, 13.48, 17.13 or 19.34, part 3, 4 or 5 of Article 20.1, or Article 20.3.1, 20.3.2, 20.3.3, 20.3.4, 20.29 or 20.33 of this Code.

units.text: 4. A minor against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted may be removed during consideration of circumstances whose discussion could have an adverse effect on that minor.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 25.1

units.text: Article 25.2. Victim
units.label: Art. 25.2

units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 25.2. Victim
units.label: Art. 25.2

units.text: 1. A victim is an individual or legal entity that has suffered physical, property or moral harm as a result of an administrative offence.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 25.2

units.text: 2. A victim shall have the right to examine all materials of the administrative offence case and audio and video recordings; make extracts from the case materials; make copies of those materials at their own expense, including by technical means; give explanations; submit evidence, motions and challenges; use the legal assistance of a representative; appeal the ruling in the case; and exercise other procedural rights under this Code.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 25.2

units.text: 3. An administrative offence case shall be considered with the participation of the victim. In the victim’s absence, the case may be considered only where there is information confirming that the victim was duly notified of the place and time of consideration and the victim has not requested postponement of consideration or such a request has been refused.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 25.2

units.text: 4. The victim may be questioned in accordance with Article 25.6 of this Code.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 25.2

units.locator: Article 25.3. Legal representatives of an individual
units.text: Article 25.3. Legal representatives of an individual
units.label: Art. 25.3

units.locator: Article 25.3. Legal representatives of an individual
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 25.3. Legal representatives of an individual
units.label: Art. 25.3

units.locator: Article 25.3. Legal representatives of an individual
units.text: 1. The rights and legitimate interests of an individual against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted, or of a victim, who is a minor or is unable to exercise their rights independently owing to their physical or mental condition, shall be protected by their legal representatives.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 25.3

units.locator: Article 25.3. Legal representatives of an individual
units.text: 2. The legal representatives of an individual are their parents, adoptive parents, guardians or trustees.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 25.3

units.locator: Article 25.3. Legal representatives of an individual
units.text: 3. Family relationships or the relevant authority of persons who are legal representatives of an individual shall be certified by the documents provided for by law.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 25.3

units.locator: Article 25.3. Legal representatives of an individual
units.text: 4. Legal representatives of an individual against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted and of a victim shall have the rights and bear the duties provided for by this Code for the persons they represent.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 25.3

units.locator: Article 25.3. Legal representatives of an individual
units.text: 5. When considering an administrative offence case involving a person under eighteen years of age, the judge, body or official considering the case may declare the presence of that person’s legal representative mandatory.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 25.3

units.locator: Article 25.4. Legal representatives of a legal entity
units.text: Article 25.4. Legal representatives of a legal entity
units.label: Art. 25.4

units.locator: Article 25.4. Legal representatives of a legal entity
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 25.4. Legal representatives of a legal entity
units.label: Art. 25.4

units.locator: Article 25.4. Legal representatives of a legal entity
units.text: 1. The rights and legitimate interests of a legal entity against which proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted, or of a legal entity that is a victim, shall be protected by its legal representatives.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 25.4

units.locator: Article 25.4. Legal representatives of a legal entity
units.text: 2. Under this Code, the legal representatives of a legal entity are its head and any other person recognised by law or the constituent documents as an organ of the legal entity. The authority of a legal representative of a legal entity shall be confirmed by documents certifying their official position.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 25.4

units.locator: Article 25.4. Legal representatives of a legal entity
units.text: 3. An administrative offence case concerning an offence committed by a legal entity shall be considered with the participation of its legal representative or defence counsel. In their absence, the case may be considered only in the cases provided for by parts 3 and 3.1 of Article 28.6 of this Code, or where there is information confirming that those persons were duly notified of the place and time of consideration and they have not requested postponement of consideration or such a request has been refused.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 25.4

units.locator: Article 25.4. Legal representatives of a legal entity
units.text: 4. When considering an administrative offence case concerning an offence committed by a legal entity, the judge, body or official handling the case may declare the presence of the legal entity’s legal representative mandatory.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 25.4

units.text: Article 25.5. Defence counsel and representative
units.label: Art. 25.5

units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 25.5. Defence counsel and representative
units.label: Art. 25.5

units.text: 1. Defence counsel may participate in proceedings in an administrative offence case to provide legal assistance to the person against whom proceedings are conducted, and a representative may participate to provide legal assistance to the victim.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 25.5

units.text: 2. An advocate or another person may be admitted to participate in proceedings in an administrative offence case as defence counsel or representative.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 25.5

units.text: 3. An advocate’s authority shall be certified by a warrant issued by the relevant advocates’ practice organisation. The authority of another person providing legal assistance shall be certified by a power of attorney executed in accordance with law.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 25.5

units.text: 4. Defence counsel and a representative shall be admitted to participate in proceedings in an administrative offence case from the moment the case is initiated.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 25.5

units.text: 5. Defence counsel and representatives admitted to participate in proceedings in an administrative offence case shall have the right to examine all case materials and audio and video recordings; make extracts from the case materials; make copies of those materials at their own expense, including by technical means; submit evidence, motions and challenges; participate in consideration of the case; appeal the application of measures securing proceedings and the ruling in the case; and exercise other procedural rights under this Code.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 25.5

units.text: 6. Participation of defence counsel in proceedings in a case concerning an administrative offence committed outside the Russian Federation and provided for by Article 13.14.1, 13.15, 13.36, 13.37, 13.48, 17.13 or 19.34, part 3, 4 or 5 of Article 20.1, or Article 20.3.1, 20.3.2, 20.3.3, 20.3.4, 20.29 or 20.33 of this Code, or an administrative offence consisting in failure to pay within the period specified by this Code an administrative fine imposed for such an administrative offence, shall be mandatory if, at the time the relevant administrative offence case is considered, the person against whom proceedings are conducted is outside the Russian Federation and there is no possibility of duly notifying that person in accordance with this Code. The judge, body or official considering the administrative offence case shall take measures to appoint defence counsel. Requirements for defence counsel, the appointment procedure and the procedure for determining the amount payable to defence counsel shall be established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 25.5

units.locator: Article 25.5.1. Presidential Commissioner for the Protection of Entrepreneurs’ Rights of the Russian Federation and commissioner for the protection of entrepreneurs’ rights in a constituent entity of the Russian Federation
units.text: Article 25.5.1. Presidential Commissioner for the Protection of Entrepreneurs’ Rights of the Russian Federation and commissioner for the protection of entrepreneurs’ rights in a constituent entity of the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 25.5.1

units.locator: Article 25.5.1. Presidential Commissioner for the Protection of Entrepreneurs’ Rights of the Russian Federation and commissioner for the protection of entrepreneurs’ rights in a constituent entity of the Russian Federation
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 25.5.1. Presidential Commissioner for the Protection of Entrepreneurs’ Rights of the Russian Federation and commissioner for the protection of entrepreneurs’ rights in a constituent entity of the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 25.5.1

units.locator: Article 25.5.1. Presidential Commissioner for the Protection of Entrepreneurs’ Rights of the Russian Federation and commissioner for the protection of entrepreneurs’ rights in a constituent entity of the Russian Federation
units.text: The Presidential Commissioner for the Protection of Entrepreneurs’ Rights of the Russian Federation and the commissioner for the protection of entrepreneurs’ rights in a constituent entity of the Russian Federation may, upon the motion of a person against whom proceedings in a case concerning an administrative offence in the field of entrepreneurial activity are conducted, be admitted to participate in the case as defence counsel.
units.label: Art. 25.5.1 · text

units.text: Article 25.6. Witness
units.label: Art. 25.6

units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 25.6. Witness
units.label: Art. 25.6

units.text: 1. A person who may know circumstances of an administrative offence case that are to be established may be summoned as a witness in the case.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 25.6

units.text: 2. A witness shall appear when summoned by the judge, body or official handling the administrative offence case and give truthful testimony: disclose everything known to the witness concerning the case, answer the questions asked and certify by signing the relevant record that the testimony has been recorded correctly.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 25.6

units.text: 3. A witness shall have the right:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 25.6

units.text: 1) not to testify against themselves, their spouse or close relatives;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 25.6

units.text: 2) to testify in their native language or a language they know;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 25.6

units.text: 3) to receive the free assistance of an interpreter;
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 25.6

units.text: 4) to make comments on the accuracy with which their testimony has been entered in the record.
units.label: Point 4 Part 3 Art. 25.6

units.text: 4. A teacher or psychologist must be present when a minor witness under fourteen years of age is questioned. Where necessary, questioning shall take place in the presence of the minor witness’s legal representative.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 25.6

units.text: 5. A witness shall be warned of administrative liability for knowingly giving false testimony.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 25.6

units.text: 6. For refusal or evasion of the duties provided for by part 2 of this Article, a witness shall bear administrative liability under this Code.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 25.6

units.text: Note. In this Article, close relatives means parents, children, adoptive parents, adopted children, siblings, grandparents and grandchildren.
units.label: Art. 25.6 · “Note. In this Article, close relatives means parents, children,…”

units.text: Article 25.7. Attesting witness
units.label: Art. 25.7

units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 25.7. Attesting witness
units.label: Art. 25.7

units.text: 1. In the cases provided for by this Code, the official handling an administrative offence case may engage as an attesting witness any adult with no interest in the outcome of the case. There must be at least two attesting witnesses.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 25.7

units.text: 2. In the cases provided for by part 12 of Article 12.21.1 (in respect of administrative offences whose consideration falls within the competence of the federal executive body exercising federal state transport supervision), Chapter 27 and Article 28.1.1 of this Code, the presence of attesting witnesses or the use of video recording shall be mandatory. An attesting witness shall certify by signing the record that procedural actions were carried out in their presence, their content and their results.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 25.7

units.text: 3. The participation of attesting witnesses in proceedings in an administrative offence case shall be entered in the record.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 25.7

units.text: 4. An attesting witness may make comments on the procedural actions being carried out. Those comments shall be entered in the record.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 25.7

units.text: 5. Where necessary, an attesting witness may be questioned as a witness in accordance with Article 25.6 of this Code.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 25.7

units.text: 6. Where video recording is used to record procedural actions, other than a personal search, those actions shall be carried out without attesting witnesses, and this shall be entered in the relevant record or alcohol intoxication examination certificate. Materials obtained during procedural actions using video recording shall be attached to the relevant record or alcohol intoxication examination certificate.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 25.7

units.text: Article 25.8. Specialist
units.label: Art. 25.8

units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 25.8. Specialist
units.label: Art. 25.8

units.text: 1. Any adult with no interest in the outcome of the case and possessing the knowledge necessary to assist in detecting, securing and seizing evidence and in using technical means may be engaged as a specialist in proceedings in an administrative offence case.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 25.8

units.text: 2. A specialist shall:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 25.8

units.text: 1) appear when summoned by the judge, body or official handling the administrative offence case;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 25.8

units.text: 2) participate in actions requiring specialised knowledge for the purpose of detecting, securing and seizing evidence, and give explanations concerning the actions they perform;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 25.8

units.text: 3) certify by their signature that those actions were performed, their content and their results.
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 25.8

units.text: 3. A specialist shall be warned of administrative liability for knowingly giving false explanations.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 25.8
